snippet.title: 桃香（を）ワッショイ [ Momowasho ] // Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642370/_/

Momowasho, a mysterious mini-game born from the “Girls Band Cry” anime, has unexpectedly been released!

Control Nina and Subaru and send Momoka back to her sofa at home!

Developed by 
TOEI ANIMATION Co.,Ltd aka @girlsbandcry
